name: Anthropic skills
summary: Anthropic's public GitHub repository of example Agent Skills, along with a skill template and a copy of the Agent Skills spec. It covers creative and design, development, enterprise communication and document (docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx) skills. It also works as a Claude Code plugin marketplace.
facts: Mostly Apache-2.0; document skills are source-available
goodFor: Reference examples when writing your own skills
Document skills for Office files and PDFs
Starting from skill-creator and the template
watchOut: Provided for demonstration; test before critical use
docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx skills are not open source
